links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI model assistance across experience levels
links.effect: In the external validation group of 120 patients, Model D significantly improved diagnostic accuracy across all radiologist experience levels, with junior radiologists improving most (+20.9%).
